source.document: Targocid powder for solution for injection/infusion SmPC (English)

key_sections_summary: Loading 6 or 12 mg/kg q12h ×3–5 then daily; from day 4 CrCl 30–80 half, <30 & HD one-third; HD does not remove; CAPD 6 mg/kg IV load then 20 mg/L in dialysate; trough ≥15 FPIA; t1/2 100–170 h; 80% unchanged urine.
note: Our paraphrase of the regulator product information; numbers copied exactly. Not rendered as text.
search_links_note: External search pages (Spain CIMA, in Spanish), checked to return at least one product; text not reproduced. UK MHRA, Ireland HPRA and NZ Medsafe are not linked: their searches render in the browser or need a form post, so a link could not be verified.
